# CSI_Temporal_Encoding

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The transformation of raw WiFi CSI amplitude/phase variations over time into a spatiotemporal representation for reservoir input. Enables extraction of motion or environmental features from wireless signals, critical for TCC's sensing-to-compute pipeline.
